I offer millions of thanks for this opportunity I have received to come and give testimony at the altar where the Holy Mother of Kreupasanam appeared alive,
My name is Martin Thomas. I come from Wayanad, from the Immaculate Heart Church parish.
It was in 13/05/2025 that I first took the Covenant.
I am standing here to talk about the blessings I received after taking the Covenant.
I renewed this Covenant in the past 21/03/2026. When I renewed it, my brother-in-law Joseph had a fatal disease,
and I had placed that too as a prayer intention.
Regarding that disease, and the miraculous healing he received from it,
my brother-in-law Joseph lives in Bangalore, and Joseph himself will speak to you about that miraculous healing.
Standing on this holy ground where my Holy Mother appeared alive, I give millions of thanks to the Mother and the Mother's Son for blessing me to give this testimony.
My name is Joseph TD. I come from Carmelaram Mount Carmel Forane Church in Bangalore.
This is my wife's younger brother, Martin Thomas.
This month, this year, on April 16th, when my blood was tested,
the test report came back positive, showing that I had contracted both Dengue and Typhoid together.
Then my doctor told me, 'Let us treat the Dengue first, and once that is cured, we can treat the Typhoid.'
So, when my blood was tested for Dengue, in the first test my hemoglobin was eight.
When tested a second time, it became 7.5. The third time, it became 7. The fourth time, it became 6.8.
By then, the Dengue became negative, and after that, the Typhoid also became negative. But my family doctor didn't tell me this;
he told my son, 'Your Daddy's blood has 65 percent bad cells. Therefore, we must do a detailed examination.
So, you should go to St. John's Medical Hospital in Bangalore.'
He also introduced us to a professor he knew. We went there and got admitted.
When they conducted all the tests, they found I had an illness called AML, which is a type of blood cancer.
This isn't measured in stages; it has three types: Type One, Type Two, and Type Three.
Type One can be treated and cured quickly. Type Two takes longer to treat, but it will be cured.
But if it is Type Three, no treatment will work on it. So they decided to start giving me medicine.
They said I had to do seven cycles. In one cycle, there are seven injections and 28 pills.
So they said we could start the first month's treatment.
Before this, on Monday morning, my elder brother's son who is in Bangalore, and his friend, who is the Head of Neurology at the Medical College,
both came to see me. He looked at my file and said, 'Oh, this is blood cancer.
There is no treatment for this. Therefore, let us pray.' Like the retreat masters, he had a cross in his hand.
He placed it, laid his hands on my head, and prayed for a good death. Then, as he was leaving, he told me, 'Don't tell them that I said this.
They will come and explain everything to you themselves.' It was after that my doctor came and said,
'Let us start the treatment today itself—seven injections and 28 pills.'
So, when I learned that this was my condition, I called my parish priest.
My first parish priest, who built our church in Bangalore, is now retired and is here in Palai. So I called him and said,
'Father, this is my condition. I am admitted at St. John's. Therefore, if I die,
you must come and conduct my funeral service. You must be the chief celebrant at my home, the church, and the cemetery, and conduct my funeral service.'
Immediately, the priest told me, 'Son, but you will only die after living another 10 years! Even so, I will come and do everything.'
After that, I called my brother-in-law. My brother-in-law asked me to send a photo of the medicine they were administering, and I sent that photo.
When he did a lot of research on this disease, he realized that it is a highly fatal illness.
He asked when I would be discharged, and I said Thursday. By Thursday evening itself,
my brother-in-law came to Bangalore. He came and told me, 'Let us go to Kreupasanam this Friday itself. I came specifically to take you there.'
Then, my son said, 'Daddy, you've taken a lot of leave this month, haven't you? We can't take leave again this Friday.

As soon as my brother-in-law arrived to see me, he had brought the blessed oil from Kreupasanam.
